faq.q: How do I make a product photo background white?
faq.a: Upload one clear product photo, choose a white background and download the finished listing image; a white background tool avoids booking a studio or masking it by hand.

faq.q: Does Amazon require a white background for product photos?
faq.a: Amazon and other marketplaces can set category rules for the main image. Check the current rule for your category before you publish.

faq.q: Can a white background keep product depth?
faq.a: Even light and a soft contact shadow keep the item readable while the background stays white.

faq.q: Can I post white background product photos on Amazon or Shopify?
faq.a: Yes. Check each channel's current rule, then add the downloaded white background product photo to your listing or product media.

faq.q: How many credits does one photo use?
faq.a: You see the cost before you start. One photo uses 24 credits, and failed jobs return the credits.

faq.q: Can one white background treatment cover my catalog?
faq.a: Yes. Apply one white background treatment across product photos so shoppers see a consistent first image.
